content.query:
SELECT 
    CustomerId 
    ,CustomerEstablishedDate
    ,InsertDttm
    ,SourceSystemCode
    ,CustomerEstablishedDate AS ValidStartDate
    --,LEAD(CustomerEstablishedDate, 1, 0) OVER (ORDER BY CustomerID ,CustomerEstablishedDate ,InsertDttm ,SourceSystemCode) AS ValidEndDate
FROM BNKM.Customer
ORDER BY 
    CustomerId 
    ,CustomerEstablishedDate
    ,InsertDttm
    ,SourceCode
    ,SourceSystemCode
